profileName: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding

cases.target: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
cases.input: A half-hourly electricity reading from a revenue-grade meter is recorded as an activity datum.
cases.expect: qualityClass is measured and acquisitionMethod is metered; the two fields are stored separately and the meter observation is cited as evidence on WM-MAT-008.
cases.violates: Every activity datum carries exactly one qualityClass from the closed set measured, estimated, modelled, allocated, spendProxy.

cases.target: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
cases.input: An activity datum records qualityClass as derived.
cases.expect: The datum is rejected; derived is an acquisitionMethod refinement, not a quality class.
cases.violates: Every activity datum carries exactly one qualityClass from the closed set measured, estimated, modelled, allocated, spendProxy.

cases.target: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
cases.input: One activity datum asserts both measured and spendProxy quality classes for the same quantity.
cases.expect: The datum is rejected because exactly one quality class is permitted.
cases.violates: Every activity datum carries exactly one qualityClass from the closed set measured, estimated, modelled, allocated, spendProxy.

cases.target: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
cases.input: An Activity Data root with its own identity and lifecycle is proposed alongside the profile.
cases.expect: The proposal is rejected; activity data is profiled over WM-FLW-015 and WM-MAT-008 and receives no root and no identifier.
cases.violates: A new Activity Data root is forbidden; the profile allocates no identifier.

cases.target: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
cases.input: A metered electricity consumption quantity is carried as a WM-MAT-008 observation and simultaneously as a WM-FLW-015 consumption fact for the same source, interval and quantity kind.
cases.expect: The second carrier is rejected; consumption quantities are carried on WM-FLW-015 and cite WM-MAT-008 observations as evidence only.
cases.violates: Exactly one activity-datum carrier exists per source, interval and quantity kind.

cases.target: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
cases.input: Annual cloud spend of 1.2 million in a stated currency and currency year supports an EEIO-based estimate.
cases.expect: qualityClass is spendProxy; monetaryAmount, currency, currencyYear, deflatorRef and eeioFactorVersionRef sit in proxyBasis; the physical quantity field remains unknown; the resulting impact quantity carries wide uncertainty and low representativeness.
cases.violates: proxyBasis is never read as a physical quantity and never as an impact quantity.
